reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE below 79,650.0. That is 260.1 points under spot and it sits 112.1 points - 0.52 hourly ATRs on the 216.90 reading - BENEATH the 79,762.1 session low printed at 08:48 UTC, the only fresh wick this half-session has left behind. The 0.5-ATR-beyond-a-proven-wick spacing is kept unchanged for a ninth session because it has now resolved correctly on eight of the last eight. A settled close under 79,650 would mean the higher low failed, the recovery off 79,570.0 was a dead-cat, and the 79,570.0 and 79,546.8 shelves are back in play with the 869,402 USD long-liquidation bucket sitting right underneath them.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE above 80,135.0. That is 224.9 points over spot and 112.0 points - 0.52 hourly ATRs - ABOVE the 80,023.0 session high, deliberately outside the wick that has already rejected price once this half-session. It also clears the 80,000 shelf and the 80,113.3 overnight high in one move, which is the only thing that would turn this from a recovery inside a range into a genuine break.

decisionBox.changed: Position stays ADD for a second consecutive session, but the reasoning has rotated from rescue to confirmation. Midnight added into a one-sided long flush on the theory that cleared leverage is a floor; that theory has now been tested and it held - price made a higher low at 79,762.1 rather than retesting 79,570.0, and it did so while funding decayed from +0.0000667 percent to essentially zero and the account ratio eased from 1.13 to 1.11. The add here is deliberately SMALLER than midnight's because price is 148 points higher and sits near the top of a 260.9-point intraday range, not near its floor. Both gates move up with the structure: reduce from 79,455.0 to 79,650.0, add from 80,230.0 to 80,135.0.

liquidation.note: 1,141,825 USD across 64 fills, 1,111,774 of it SHORT against only 30,051 long. Crucially this bucket has SHRUNK since the midnight read (1,191,230 USD) rather than grown, even though price tagged 80,023.0 at 10:57 UTC. Old fills rolled out of the 100-fill window and almost nothing new replaced them, which confirms the endday and midnight read: this is a SPENT cluster. The shorts stacked there were forced to buy during the overnight push and have already bought. Magnet stays FALSE - what is overhead is a ceiling made of people who no longer hold a position.

253,931 USD across 6 fills, 239,419 of it LONG. This is the one genuinely NEW thing on the map: at midnight this bucket held 7,970 USD across 4 fills and was 100 percent short. Two large long liquidations landed here during the 08:48 UTC dip to 79,762.1 - a thirty-two-fold increase in four hours. It marks where the second, smaller wave of long leverage was cleaned out, 160 points under spot, and it is why the higher low is credible rather than cosmetic.

869,402 USD across 30 fills, still 100 percent LONG with zero short fills, and byte-for-byte unchanged from the midnight read - the same 07:00 UTC flush is simply still inside the rolling window. It is flagged magnet because it remains the largest one-sided pocket below and because the level that produced it, 79,570.0, has now gone four and a half hours without a retest. Untested lows are the ones that eventually get tested.

liquidityMagnet.note: Pull is BALANCED and that is a change from midnight's DOWN. The three inputs that made the downside pull real four hours ago have all decayed. The OKX 1H long/short account ratio has eased from 1.13 to 1.11, so longs are still the crowded side by head count but less so. timeframes.structure: Fully repaired and re-stacked. At midnight the four averages were bunched 79,761.7 to 79,878.0 with price underneath three of them; they are now cleanly ordered 20 > 50 > 100 > 200 and price at 79,910.1 sits between the 50 at 79,895.2 and the 20 at 79,920.3, using the band as support rather than fighting it. The MACD histogram has swung from -28.1 to +8.7 and RSI from 36.4 to 53.3. The last three 15m bars have narrowed to a 79,900-to-79,991 coil directly under the 20 EMA.

The frame that resolved the midnight question. Four hours ago price was trapped in a 101.7-point corridor between the 20 EMA above and the 50 EMA below; it has since closed back above BOTH and now sits above all four hourly averages. The last four settled closes are 79,821.2, 79,851.9, 79,887.4 and 80,001.2 - a clean ascending sequence, and the 10:00 UTC bar is the first settled hourly close above 80,000 since the overnight rejection. The histogram held positive at +4.0 rather than crossing, which was the specific thing midnight flagged as one red hour away.

Price is above all four averages with the 20 EMA at 79,611.0 now 299.1 points below spot, but the histogram is negative at -71.0 and the signal line is above the MACD line - momentum on this frame is still unwinding from the 03 September spike. The live 04:00 UTC bar opened 80,036.1, wicked to 80,113.3 and 79,570.0 and is trading at 79,910.1, an outside bar so far. The 20 EMA was undercut by 41.0 points in that wick and reclaimed inside the same bar, which is the single most useful fact this frame has produced.

Untouched by any of this. Spot is above all four daily averages and 5.02 percent above the 20 EMA at 76,092.0. The last three completed daily bars are 03 September +5.07 percent to 81,260.1, 04 September -1.97 percent to 79,660.7 and 05 September +0.21 percent to 79,830.2 - a spike, a give-back and a flat day, which is a textbook digestion pattern rather than a top. RSI at 66.8 is elevated but not extended, and the histogram at -109.2 is the give-back showing up, not a trend change.
